# Tuya TV P2P Test v0.2.0 (experimental)

Experimental Android TV APK. Tuya Smart login and a read-only check for P2P video configuration availability. Does not include streaming or a 2×2 grid. No user credentials or camera identifiers are in the repository; enter account details only in the installed app. Debug-signed test build; it may not update other debug-signed installations and is not intended for the Play Store.
